dirtyCancellation.ownership: Reset-owned captured prefix is recovered inside the canceled lock callback before same-source successor execution; no successor retains serializer prefix for live edits; account/source guards and status ownership remain separate.

fallowEvidenceRule: Repository audit JSON uses synthetic materialized .nuxt commits and default threshold 20; source base/head binding requires raw stderr. Separate raw health --max-cyclomatic 4 report and original-owner function comparison verify author-introduced functions without suppressions.
historicalStages: combinedRecovery*, queuedAdoption*, resetTransition* and dirtyCancellation* fields preserve their earlier stage receipts. rootOwnership and the top-level native sources/results supersede their runtime ownership contract.

rootOwnership.contract: Uncommitted guest intent belongs to a stable source-keyed retained prefix, independently of reset/request cancellation. Any same-source ordinary or reset successor replays it. Only an authoritative guest commit or explicit scope replacement consumes it, inside the lock. Status tickets cannot consume data intent.
rootOwnership.ordering: Ordered before/after frames preserve intentional undo. Unchanged captures are skipped; a failed write folds the prefix against observed storage into one retry frame. Captured physical memory-after remains separate from the folded retry value, including 3 -> 20 -> 3 before successor execution.
rootOwnership.disposal: Explicit hydration or session memory replacement ends the old guest scope. Scheduling a refused raw owned envelope does not discard guest intent. Successful active clear consumes inside its lock callback; its delayed completion cannot consume a newer failed write.
rootOwnership.primaryHarnessChange: Copied original primary harness; only dirty canceled-without-successor pending-intent count changed from zero to one, reflecting retained ownership. Historical baseline primary receipts retain their original harness hash.

unitBaseline.note: Seven data-loss regressions and one retained-prefix ownership assertion fail on immutable baseline runtime; three clean/refused-envelope/delayed-clear controls pass. Test fixtures match final candidate and release gates before assertions.

rootOwnership.focusedReceipt: All three suites passed 403 on frozen runtime source; after moving a held-prefix assertion after gate release without changing its captured value, final cross-tab fixture passed 111. No runtime edits followed the 403 run.
